people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
translations.bsb: Abraham replied, “I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’
translations.kjv: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
translations.asv: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place. And they will slay me for my wife's sake.
